skills.title: 传感器维护与校准手册
skills.summary: 传感器停机标定、在线校准、维护记录与校准参数表。Sensor maintenance, offline calibration, online calibration and parameter tables.

sections.title: 停机后的离线标定
sections.summary: 适用于设备已停机时的传感器标定；给出流程代号和稳定等待时间，不适用于在线校准。
sections.body: 合成测试手册：停机后的离线标定使用流程代号 CAL-OFF-731，稳定等待 47 秒。记录时使用这两个精确值。

sections.title: 不停机的在线校准
sections.summary: 适用于设备仍在运行时的传感器校准；给出在线流程代号和采样窗口，不适用于停机标定。
sections.body: 合成测试手册：不停机在线校准使用流程代号 CAL-ON-284，采样窗口为 19 秒。记录时使用这两个精确值。

sections.title: 传感器更换后的登记
sections.summary: 仅用于更换传感器后的登记和编号，不包含离线或在线校准步骤。
sections.body: 合成测试手册：更换后的登记代号是 REPLACE-596，登记窗口是 83 秒。此段不是标定流程。

resources.title: 校准参数附表
resources.summary: 按离线标定和在线校准划分参数；按分块选择对应场景。

chunks.title: 停机标定参数
chunks.summary: 离线标定的基准片代码与允许偏差；不包含在线参数。
chunks.body: 合成参数表：停机标定的基准片代码是 PLATE-682，允许偏差是 0.037。

chunks.title: 在线校准参数
chunks.summary: 在线校准的基准片代码与允许偏差；不包含离线参数。
chunks.body: 合成参数表：在线校准的基准片代码是 PLATE-159，允许偏差是 0.082。

skills.title: Service delivery handbook
skills.summary: Service deployment, release rollback and rollback rehearsal. 服务部署、发布回滚与回滚演练。

sections.title: Rollback after an actual failed release
sections.summary: Use when a real service release has failed and needs rollback; includes the authorization record label and retention period. Excludes rehearsals.
sections.body: Synthetic handbook: for rollback after an actual failed release, the record label is ROLLBACK-843 and the retention period is 26 days.

sections.title: Rollback rehearsal without a failed release
sections.summary: Use only for planned drills; gives rehearsal record labels and retention. Not for an actual failed release.
sections.body: Synthetic handbook: for a rehearsal, the record label is DRILL-217 and the retention period is 11 days.

sections.title: Normal release registration
sections.summary: Use to register a successful release; not for rollback or rehearsal.
sections.body: Synthetic handbook: normal release records use RELEASE-905 and are retained for 58 days.

skills.title: 未选中的旧维护记录
skills.summary: 传感器停机标定和在线校准的旧草稿。Sensor maintenance offline online calibration.

sections.title: 旧草稿
sections.summary: 宿主未选择的过期资料。
